what.text: This page follows refugees from China living in France, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 16353 Chinese refugees in France, 10.6% of all refugees from China.
India and the United States host the most refugees from China, followed by France and Canada.

why.text: UCDP records an armed conflict over East Turkestan territory in China with ETIM in 2008, and an interstate armed conflict between China and India in 2020.
The fact pack does not link these conflicts to the refugee figures.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 1995 at 1003 refugees.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2020 to 2025, and the figure is at its highest at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in France.
These are year-end totals for France only, reported to UNHCR.
